description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 147. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 60 Ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Super Kamehameha
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (150 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
True to its name this is the strongest pure variation of
the Kamehameha.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 150 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw dealing 12d8 damage on a fail,
half on a success.
